what: The panel laid behind (below) the footer is revealed as much as the footer rises (90svh in the original), and the narrow giant title inside stretches vertically only to match the revealed share — straight (no curve) from .1x at the start to the scale that fills the revealed height leaving only top and bottom margins. The title stretches around the baseline of its last line, so it stays stuck to the bottom. Remeasured when the font or window size changes.

options.[data-fx-part=spacer]: Empty cell that creates the reveal height (required) — at the front of the panel
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Title plate fixed to the bottom (required)
options.from: Initial vertical scale (when the reveal starts), default .1 — at 1 it doesn’t stretch and only the veil lifts
options.footer: Selector for the footer covering from above, default is the previous sibling element
options.--fx-reveal: Revealed height (CSS variable), default 90svh — original is tablet 60svh · phone 30svh

note: The footer must sit above this panel (z-index 1, with a background) to cover it. The panel starts half-tucked under the footer with margin-top: -50svh. It watches window scroll (or that panel’s scroll if it is a data-fx-scroller panel)

from.where: After the footer on every page .lr-post
